item.title: Altersvorsorgedepot dürfte Nachfrage nach aktiven ETFs treiben
item.author: H+
item.description: Am europäischen Fondsmarkt sind aktive ETFs zwar weiter eine Nische, wachsen aber schnell: In Deutschland verfügbare Produkte verwalteten Ende August 119 Milliarden Euro – knapp doppelt so viel wie zwölf Monate zuvor, als es 63 Milliarden Euro waren. Die Zahl der Produkte stieg im gleichen Zeitraum von 183 auf 345.

item.title: Tech Rally Extends to Asia on Anthropic, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Anthropic’s offering will be a key test of investor appetite for AI companies after recent concerns over stretched valuations and heavy spending sparked a rout in chip stocks. Investors are also bracing for the Federal Reserve’s rate decision Wednesday and earnings from megacap companies this week, which will offer fresh clues on the outlook for the AI trade.

item.title: AI Trade Bounces Back as Anthropic IPO Eases Funding Jitters
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering filing offered a much-needed sentiment boost to the AI trade, bolstering semiconductor stocks in South Korea and Japan. Shares of Samsung Electronics Co. and SK Hynix Inc. climbed more than 4% each, pushing Korea’s equity benchmark Kospi up as much as 4.9%. Japan’s Nikkei 225 Stock Average rose as much as 2.4%, with Advantest Corp. up more than 9%.

item.title: BlackRock’s Rieder Spent All Weekend Doing Deals in AI Debt Rush
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The AI-driven debt boom is creating some of the most attractive fixed-income opportunities in years, eclipsing the appeal of long-dated US Treasuries, according to BlackRock’s Rick Rieder. “I’ve never seen anything like it in terms of the size of the financing that’s coming in both debt markets, equity markets,” the firm’s chief investment officer for global fixed income said in a Bloomberg TV interview.
